one_liner: Linear has a broad GraphQL API with self-serve OAuth2 apps and personal API keys, available on the free plan, plus an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth2 authorization-code flow with self-serve app registration, refresh tokens, optional actor=app, and client-credentials tokens. Personal API keys are also supported.
access_notes: The free plan is $0 with unlimited members. A third-party summary says API access is included in all plans, and Linear's own pricing page doesn't list the API as paid-only.
blocker_notes: None. A free workspace gives OAuth app registration and API keys.

evidence.quote: Create a new [OAuth2 Application](https://linear.app/settings/api/applications/new) and configure the redirect callback URLs to your application.
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
Free for everyone -   Unlimited members -   2 teams -   250 issues
Yes, API access included in all plans including free tier (unlimited users).
Read-write access is provided through `https://mcp.linear.app/mcp` by default.
